blurb:
Enjoy an overview of Vancouver in the comfort of your own private chauffeured vehicle. Arrange for pickup at your hotel, condo or residence at a time that suits you. Your 2-hour excursion will showcase the true magic of the city combined with the majestic beauty of the mountains, ocean and forest. Your professional chauffeur guide will ensure that your private, fully narrated tour fits your needs.

There are countless things to do and see in and around the region. Your driver and personal guide can customize your tour to include museums, galleries, shopping, kids activities, culinary delights, and more.
